text:
Grant writing takes a ton out of you, and getting the whole skeleton mapped out is a huge milestone. 

Definitely a good stopping point to close the laptop and get some rest. Whenever you're recharged and ready to tackle the actual drafting—whether that's tomorrow or next week—we can just take it one section at a time. Go take a break!
